title: Chapter 89 The Space-Time Palace Again
content:
Chapter 89 The Space-Time Palace Again

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Jiang Bei paused, had to give up the idea of taking action and retreated to Lu Daosheng's side.

At this time, Lu Daosheng also stopped what was in his hand, turned around, and looked up.

"I have had several dealings with your Time and Space Hall, and I am an old friend. Don't worry about this, what?"

Looking at the phantom, Lu Daosheng said slowly.

Hearing this, everyone present was stunned.

The Palace of Time and Space?

Jiangbei and the other three looked confused, obviously they did not know this force.

But they have heard that above the long river of time and space, there was a very strong man guarding the order of time and space.

They didn't take this seriously, but they didn't expect it to be true.

Even though I didn't expect that the strong man who guarded the order of time and space was so terrifying.

But they were not panicked, because Lu Daosheng seemed to be stronger and seemed to be very familiar with the other party's Time and Space Hall.

And the phantom frowned slightly when he heard Lu Daosheng's words.

Some people know about him in the Space and Time Palace, but he is not surprised.

But he didn't expect the other party to say that.

Old friend?

Suddenly, he said coldly: "Don't get close to my time and space palace, disrupting the order of time and space. You should die if you commit crimes!"

boom!

As soon as he finished speaking, he punched him out.

With the violent trembling of the entire long river of time and space, the powerful power of time and space suddenly poured down.

Seeing this scene, Jiangbei and the other two looked extremely solemn.

Even Jiang Bei, who is in the Divine Emperor realm, is not 100% sure to take this attack.

At this time, above the long river of time and space, the powerful man from the Time and Space Palace sneered and looked at Lu Daosheng below.

What kind of cows and horses are worthy of being close to his time and space palace.

Do you really think that calling the names of the forces behind you can save your life?

Below, facing this blow, Lu Daosheng shook his head helplessly.

He had no hostility to the Time and Space Hall. After all, this is an existence that protects the order of time and space in countless worlds. If there were no Time and Space Hall, it would have been a turmoil in all worlds.

And this is because he disrupted the order first, so Lu Daosheng said that kind of thing.

Although he has done it once or twice to disrupt time and space.

It can be said to be a habitual offender.

Lu Daosheng waved his hand lightly, and countless majestic powers of time and space suddenly dissipated into the void.

"What? You!"

Seeing this, the strong man from the Space Palace was shocked. At this moment, he knew that the other party might be a real strong man.

The long river of time and space dissipated, and the phantom also revealed the lineup. It was a young man wearing a purple long gown.

"Do you really want to be an enemy of my Time and Space Hall?"

The young man looked at Lu Daosheng and frowned.

He couldn't deal with Lu Daosheng, so he could only move out of the title of the Time and Space Hall.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I really have no hostility to the Time and Space Palace."

Lu Daosheng pointed to the grave behind him and said, "I just want to save someone."

Looking at the grave behind Lu Daosheng, the young man's eyelids twitched wildly.

"All have been dead for so long, are you serious?"

"And, I tell you that even if you go back to time, she can't survive. This cannot be solved by just time."

The young man said in a deep voice.

He was obviously extremely dissatisfied with Lu Daosheng's approach.

Hearing the young man's words, Yu Qingfeng and Kong Wen trembled all over.

"This senior, can't he really be resurrected when he dies?"

Kong Wen said tremblingly as he looked at the young man.

Hearing this, the young man snorted coldly, "Resurrection from the dead is not something that people like you can do, so don't dream."

Hearing this, Kong Wen sat on the ground in disappointment, and his self-blame from countless years ago suddenly surged into his heart again.

"Luo Li, it's my fault for the old man."

Kong Wen murmured to himself in a daze.

At this time, Yu Qingfeng suddenly said, "I believe in Senior Lu!"

Yu Qingfeng looked at Lu Daosheng with a firm look in his eyes.

"Senior, I believe you, you will definitely be able to save Luo Li."

On the side, the young man shook his head and sneered.

In his eyes, except for Lu Daosheng, these people are just clowns.

But Lu Daosheng smiled.

"Hello."

Lu Daosheng looked at the young man in the Time and Space Palace.

"How about we make a bet?"

Hearing this, the young man frowned slightly, "What are you betting on?"

Lu Daosheng pointed to the grave behind him and said, "Just bet if I can save this woman, this matter will end here."

He could have solved it with force, but it would only backfire in the end.

Because the young man is not alone, behind him is the entire Time and Space Hall.

Until now, he could not see what kind of force the Time and Space Hall was, but he understood that now, the Time and Space Hall has only revealed the tip of the iceberg.

Lu Daosheng has no reason to be an enemy of such a force.

Therefore, facing the Palace of Time and Space, Lu Daosheng has always convinced people with reason.

This is also the reason why Lu Daosheng would give the benefits of the Guardian of the Long River of Time and Space when the Hongmeng Universe and the All Spirit Realm.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, the young man said in a deep voice: "What if you lose."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng said indifferently: "I lost, I will let you deal with it."

"good!"

The young man agreed decisively.

He didn't believe that Lu Daosheng really had the ability to revive from the dead.

After all, even in the Hall of Time and Space, many seniors who were much stronger than him could not do it, let alone this guy in front of him.

Seeing that the young man agreed, Lu Daosheng smiled in his heart, and then turned around to continue the previous operation.

On the side, Yu Qingfeng and the other two looked nervous.

The young man looked disdainful, just standing aside, with a hint of sarcasm flashing from time to time.

It's just time travel, this method, he can also do it.

But then what?

What can you do next.

After an unknown amount of time, Lu Daosheng finally stopped.

As Lu Daosheng raised his hand slightly, a woman with a high appearance suddenly floated up from the ground.

"Luo Li!"

Seeing the woman, Yu Qingfeng's eyes were red.

On the side, Jiang Bei hurriedly pulled Yu Qingfeng and shook his head at him.

Seeing this, Yu Qingfeng had to calm down.

But his eyes could no longer leave Luo Li.

Looking at the woman in front of him, Lu Daosheng was silent.

It is true that simply going back in time cannot bring the dead back to life.

The woman at this time has no breath, just like she just died.

"System, what's next?"

[Host, just watch it]

I saw that the power in Lu Daosheng's palm suddenly changed, and suddenly a majestic breath of life suddenly gushed out, and then it continued to flow into the woman's body.

However, this is not over yet.

I saw a vague breath suddenly began to condense.

As the breath became more and more, a vague figure gradually appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

It looked exactly like the woman.

"Gathering souls?!"

At this time, the young man on the side suddenly lost his voice.

He had only heard of this method, but it was the first time he saw it.

But, isn't this against the rules?

Is no one in charge? ?

At the same time, in a gloomy hall, a figure full of horror was curled up in a corner, looking at the indescribable power in front of him in horror.

If he dares to act rashly, he will definitely be dead in the next moment.

And just now, he felt that someone was forcibly gathering souls from the outside world and was about to teach him a lesson.

Now it seems that he doesn't need to care.

Because he can't afford to offend.
